title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we protect your personal data

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: Aibooking.dk is committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our platform and services.

sections.heading: 2. Data controller
sections.body: Aibooking.dk (hereinafter "we" or "us") is the data controller for the processing of your personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 3. What data we collect
sections.intro: We collect the following categories of personal data:

labelItems.label: Account data
labelItems.desc: Name, email address, phone number, and other information you provide when creating an account

labelItems.label: Payment data
labelItems.desc: Billing address and payment information (processed securely via payment providers)

labelItems.label: Usage data
labelItems.desc: Information about your activities on the platform, such as bookings, enquiries, and interactions

labelItems.label: Technical data
labelItems.desc: IP address, browser type, device type, and other technical information

labelItems.label: Communication data
labelItems.desc: Emails, messages, and other communication between you and us

sections.heading: 4. How we use your data
sections.intro: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
items: To provide and administer our services
To process your bookings and transactions
To communicate with you about your account and our services
To improve and optimize our platform
To meet legal and regulatory requirements
To prevent fraud and ensure security on our platform

sections.heading: 5. Sharing of data
sections.body: We only share your personal data with third-party providers that are necessary to deliver our services, such as payment processors, hosting providers, and customer support platforms. All third-party providers are required to process your data securely and in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: 6. Data storage
sections.body: Your personal data is stored on secure servers and is not kept longer than necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, unless the law requires longer retention. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

labelItems.label: Right of access
labelItems.desc: You can request to see what personal data we hold about you

labelItems.label: Right to rectification
labelItems.desc: You can request that we correct inaccurate data

labelItems.label: Right to erasure
labelItems.desc: You can request that we delete your data

labelItems.label: Right to restriction
labelItems.desc: You can request that we restrict the use of your data

labelItems.label: Right to data portability
labelItems.desc: You can request to receive your data in a structured format

labelItems.label: Right to object
labelItems.desc: You can object to certain processing of your data

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.body: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption, secure connections, and access control.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
sections.body: Our platform may use cookies to improve your user experience. You can control cookie settings in your browser. Some cookies are necessary for the platform to function properly, while others are used to analyze user behavior.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated to you via email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the platform after changes means that you accept the new terms.

sections.heading: 11. Contact us
sections.before: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your rights, please feel free to contact us at
